column20: What do we know so far?: 'the initial trigger event was a Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attack'; secondary: 'an error in the implementation of our defenses amplified the impact of the attack'
column21: What do we know so far?: 'Azure Front Door (AFD) and Azure Content Delivery Network (CDN) components performing below acceptable thresholds'
column22: What happened?: 'issues connecting to a subset of Microsoft services globally'
column25: How did we respond?: 'performed failovers to alternate networking paths to provide relief'; 'Some customers reported less than 100% availability'
column28: DDoS initial trigger with defense-implementation error amplifying it; V5, V7 and V8 lack explicit text.
